description_en: Adds images to Security Center and creates an image scan task to scan the images
description_zh: 将镜像导入到资产中心并为该镜像创建扫描任务
name: PublicSyncAndCreateImageScanTask

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The information about the images. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

RegistryType: the type of the image repository. Valid values:

    *   acr
    *   harbor
    *   quay

RepoId: the ID of the image repository.

InstanceId: the ID of the Container Registry instance to which the image repository belongs.

RepoNamespace: the namespace to which the image repository belongs.

RegionId: the region ID of the image.

RepoName: the name of the image repository.

Digest: the digest of the image.

Tag: the tag that is added to the image.

CreateTime: the timestamp when the image was created. Unit: milliseconds.

UpdateTime: the timestamp when the image was updated. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
要导入资产中心的镜像的信息。该参数为JSON格式，包含以下字段：

RegistryType：镜像仓的类型。取值：
    - acr
    - harbor
    - quay
RepoId：镜像仓的ID。
InstanceId：ACR镜像仓实例的ID。
RepoNamespace：镜像仓的命名空间。
RegionId：镜像的地域ID。
RepoName：镜像仓的名称。
Digest：镜像的摘要。
Tag：镜像的标签。
CreateTime：镜像创建的时间戳，单位为毫秒。
UpdateTime：镜像更新的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: images

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

CanCreate.description_en:
Indicates whether you can create more image scan tasks. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no

By default, a maximum of 10 image scan tasks can be running at the same time. If 10 image scan tasks are running, you cannot create an image scan task by calling this operation. You must wait for at least one of the 10 existing image scan tasks to complete before you can create an image scan task
CanCreate.description_zh:
是否可以继续创建扫描任务。取值：

true：可以继续创建扫描任务。
false：无法继续创建扫描任务。

默认支持同时存在10个扫描任务，超过10个扫描任务时，使用本接口创建扫描任务会失败。您需要等待已有的10个扫描任务中有扫描任务完成后，才可以继续创建新的扫描任务

CollectTime.description_en: The timestamp when the image information was collected. Unit: milliseconds
CollectTime.description_zh: 采集镜像信息的时间戳，单位为毫秒

ExecTime.description_en: The timestamp when the image scan task started to run. Unit: milliseconds
ExecTime.description_zh: 扫描任务开始运行的时间戳，单位为毫秒

FinishCount.description_en: The number of images that have been scanned
FinishCount.description_zh: 已完成扫描的镜像的数量

Progress.description_en: The progress of the image scan task

Result.description_en:
The result of the image scan task. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The task is successful.
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION: The image is deployed in a region that is not supported by container image scan
Result.description_zh:
扫描任务的执行结果。取值：

SUCCESS：扫描任务执行成功
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION：镜像在不支持扫描的地域

Status.description_en:
The status of the image scan task. Valid values:

INIT: The task is being initialized.
PRE_ANALYZER: The task is being pre-processed.
SUCCESS: The task is successful.
FAIL: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
扫描任务的状态。取值：

INIT：初始化中
PRE_ANALYZER：预分析中
SUCCESS：执行成功
FAIL：执行失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the image scan task

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of images to scan

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
